# Sprites Creative

1,000 copy-paste Lovable mega-prompts pairing ten creative disciplines with the
four fly.io Sprites primitives: Sprite Sandbox (public micro-VM), Filesystem
Drop, Long-running Service, and One-shot Exec. One API token (`SPRITES_TOKEN`
from sprites.dev/account), one Lovable build per idea.

Built during the Sprites Creative Hackathon — StreetKode Fam · Indian
Krump Festival 14.

## Reference implementation

- https://github.com/arunnadarasa/sprite-sandbox-fun — end-to-end example: a
  single Lovable build that creates a public Sprite, writes to /root/www, runs
  a wake-on-request service on port 8080, and warm-polls the URL.
